title: Adam Rodman – The Case for Nuclear (Climate Solutions EP.4, Capital Allocators EP.304)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Adam Rodman is the Founder and Chief Investment Officer of Segra Capital Management.
reader_summary.overview: Adam Rodman is the Founder and Chief Investment Officer of Segra Capital Management. Adam founded Segra in 2013 to focus on a concentrated portfolio of contrarian, underfollowed investment ideas. In turn, this led to a dedicated focus on nuclear power.

key_points.text: Adam Rodman is the Founder and Chief Investment Officer of Segra Capital Management.
Both Tom Steyer and Bill Orum discussed nuclear power as an essential, although very long-term component of addressing climate needs.
Adam's insights provide an understanding of the thesis as well as nuances in capitalizing on it.
